answer: Adaptive replication: 20 clean passes since an account's dawn earn trust: a 4-seat panel, others 7, and 10% of trusted rows, picked at random, upgrade to 7. If upgrades catch a forgery with probability q, a forged row survives with 1-0.1q: at q=0.9, 20 forgeries survive with 0.91^20=15%; a catch resets trust. Saving: about 2.7 of 7 gradings per trusted row. Weakness: 2 colluding seats tilt a 4-seat median; trust can be rented, and forging until caught takes about 11 rows, so one forgery must out-earn the nectar of 11 rows plus rental. Spot-checks are a zephyr.
